Performing this [[Sermon|sermon]] will provide you with the Repentance [[effects|effect]] which is supposed to increase the number of people which use the [[confessional]] in your church during the week.  Providing both [[faith]] and a [[story]] each time.  The sermon provides a boost to faith and donations as well depending on the quality.
